lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the auto-dispatcher into the sidecar idle-tick

nextStoryContext: US-004 is done. makeProductionMetaLoopDispatchFn is exported from src/commands/sidecar.ts. It is a factory that builds a closure over injectable MetaLoopDispatchDeps (selectFn, readPhaseFn, prdPresentFn, mergeWatchPresentFn, preconditionFn, killSwitchFn, setPhaseFn, drainNotifyFn, warnFn, logEvent). The auto-dispatcher is wired into the runMetaLoopObserveFn seam in buildSidecarLoopDeps via buildMetaLoopFn which branches on meta_loop=auto. The 'meta-loop-dispatch' WorkerEventKind and MetaLoopDispatchEventDetail union are in src/supervisor/events.ts. ADR 0007 documents the decision. All 3155 tests pass. The sidecar idle-tick now dispatches phase:planning for the next plannable issue when all safe-boundary guards pass in meta_loop=auto mode.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-004 touches only project-internal modules (sidecar.ts helpers, events.ts types, observe.ts, drain-preconditions.ts, drain-kill-switch.ts, select.ts). No external library API was exercised.
